message:
So on Linux, `GF_MAX_PATH` is `PATH_MAX` which is typically 4096. Let me check:

<｜｜DSML｜｜execute_bash>
<parameter=command>echo '#include <limits.h>
#include <stdio.h>
int main() { printf("PATH_MAX=%d\n", PATH_MAX); return 0; }' > /tmp/test_path.c && gcc /tmp/test_path.c -o /tmp/test_path && /tmp/test_path</｜｜DSML｜｜execute_bash>
